facts.value: The central student advisory service supports you competently with all concerns related to studying.
The student secretariat is your reliable point of contact for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
The examination offices have contacts for all formal matters related to your academic performance such as thesis, exam registration, or certificates.
Goethe University supports international students with comprehensive advisory and service offerings from application to graduation.

PBS offers you support and a listening ear for personal concerns. In addition to individual discussions, they provide online lectures and workshops each semester on themes such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management.

PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blocks. In addition to individual and couple counseling, they also offer group services.
In addition to a diverse sports program, university sports also offers courses and videos on stress management and self-assertion as well as events to become active and make new contacts.

The career service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) in starting their careers. Strengthen your career competencies through workshops, coaching, and networks - free, practical, and individual - your springboard to the job.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and critical environment concerning discrimination and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Counseling in discrimination cases as well as measures for the prevention and reduction of discrimination.
The ombudspersons are your contacts for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding your studies and doctoral programs.
The scholarship service supports students and staff of all departments. Find your scholarship and benefit from individual advising.
The student services provide affordable housing close to campus. Discover numerous dormitories, learn about rent prices, and apply online for your room.
BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans – the student services in Frankfurt inform about all possibilities of study financing and provide individual counseling.
